auszuege.business: Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum products in China and internationally. It offers electrolytic, liquid, recycled, and oxidized aluminum, as well as aluminum alloy, aluminum hydroxide, alumina, and deep-processed aluminum products. The company is also involved in trading; investment management; and logistics businesses. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shandong Hontron Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited and changed its name to Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited in January 2026. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Binzhou, China. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Weiqiao Aluminum and Electricity Co., Ltd.
